pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: join ANC visits and livelihoods by district and year, 2023 ANC and employment rates side by side
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: SELECT a.district, a.year, (100.0 * a.anc4_completed / NULLIF(NULLIF(a.pregnancies_registered, 0), 0)) AS anc_rate, (100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / NULLIF(NULLIF(l.women_enrolled, 0), 0)) AS employment_rate FROM anc_visits AS a JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023

```sql

SELECT 
  a.district,
  a.year,
  (100.0 * a.anc4_completed / NULLIF(a.pregnancies_registered, 0)) AS anc_rate,
  (100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / NULLIF(l.women_enrolled, 0)) AS employment_rate
FROM anc_visits a
JOIN livelihoods l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year
WHERE a.year = 2023;
